corrections_to_memory.replace: Spruce lost substantial revenue; removing explanatory copy is a failed approach and must not be revisited.
corrections_to_memory.with: Spruce deployed copy removal and was actually rolled back after an apparent 40% revenue loss. A later settled-order-ledger reconciliation found omitted treatment wallet orders and revised the comparison to $50,000 control versus $51,000 variant on 10,000 sessions each (+2% revenue per session). The old failure conclusion is superseded; uncertainty remains, so neither a permanent blacklist nor a winner claim is supported. Detailed_offer remains live. A fresh controlled retest is reasonable.

limitations: Only synthetic local records were used. No live validation or product changes were authorized or performed.
The corrected historical totals provide no variance, confidence interval, power analysis, randomization details or sufficient evidence of a winner; statistical significance cannot be inferred.

Current baseline distribution, traffic volume, minimum worthwhile effect, settlement lag and acceptable loss threshold are unspecified. These must be supplied or measured before setting a credible experiment size and stopping rules.
No relevant audience or pricing change is recorded; absence of a record does not establish that every product condition is identical to 2025.
